description:
This Grade II listed Georgian townhouse, situated in a conservation area, has been thoughtfully converted into two flats.

The ground floor flat comprises one bedroom, a living room, dining kitchen, and bathroom, while the first floor flat offers two bedrooms, a living room, dining kitchen, and bathroom. Both flats boast private rear yards, ideal for outdoor relaxation.

This property presents an excellent investment opportunity with the potential for conversion back into a family home. Perfectly positioned to enjoy an urban lifestyle, residents can take advantage of the nearby amenities and greenspaces.

Don't miss out on this versatile property that offers both investment potential and the option for a spacious family residence. Contact us today to arrange a viewing and explore the possibilities this townhouse has to offer.

Directions From Lowther Street turn right onto Lonsdale Street and then continue onto Chiswick Street.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • Vehicle parking is on road. (Permit required) • The property is Grade II listed • The property is in a conservation zone.
